function.name: game_list_get_games
function.description: Get a list of video games based on release year, multiplayer functionality and ESRB rating Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

release_year.description: The year the game was released.

multiplayer.description: Whether the game has multiplayer functionality.

ESRB_rating.description: The ESRB rating of the game.
